## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Related issue

Link the related issue, if one exists.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated edits.
- [ ] The project starts, builds, or passes its documented checks.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated when relevant.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, generated files, or personal data were added.
- [ ] Breaking changes and migration steps are documented.
